purpose: Test within-domain persistence and deterioration edges in source-defined WGI annual observations

candidate_edges.source_rule: absolute change from previous source observation <= 0.25
candidate_edges.target_rule: absolute change at next source observation <= 0.25

splits: chronological by target source year: fit 2006-2015, validation 2016-2019, confirmation 2020-2024 where available
missing_data: complete-case on adjacent source observations; no imputation
promotion_requires: OOS, null separation, entity stability, methodology review, and supervisor admission
